headline.purpose: View and section titles (dashboard heading, panel titles).

title.purpose: Card titles, note titles, dialog headers.

body.purpose: Note content and reading surfaces; cap prose at 65-75ch.

caption.purpose: Small supporting text between label and body — empty states, loading text, inline error callouts (0.8125rem/13px).

small.purpose: Dense UI text — chips, pills, secondary meta (0.75rem/12px).

compact.purpose: Just under body — list rows, dense labels, sub-text (0.875rem/14px).

label.purpose: Small uppercase mono kickers/captions; a deliberate system voice, not on every block.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift — chips, small popovers, hover raises.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, the composer pill, inline menus.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-feedback: color/border shifts on hover and focus.

motion.name: ease-press
motion.purpose: The .pressable scale(0.97) press response — the one place a slight spring is allowed.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strong call to action in a dialog or action bar. Accent is spent here and nowhere else nearby.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #7c6af7); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #7c6af7); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); padding: 0.45rem 0.95rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6af7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default quiet button (cancel, secondary action). Border over fill; no accent at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--text-2, #9896a4); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a32); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover, #3d3d4a); color: var(--text-1, #f0eff5); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6af7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirms only (delete, restore). Same shape as primary, danger color.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--danger, #e05252); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--danger, #e05252); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); padding: 0.45rem 0.95rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--danger, #e05252); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line text field. Sits on --bg, below its surface; focus shifts the border to accent (no glow).
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--bg, #0d0d0f); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a32); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); color: var(--text-1, #f0eff5); padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-3, #6d6b75); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #7c6af7); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: A note/content card. Flat at rest — tonal surface + hairline border, no shadow. Never nest a card in a card.
components.html:
Note title

A calm surface that lets the note's own content stand forward.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface, #141417); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a32); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 14px); padding: 1.25rem; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-hover, #3d3d4a); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-1, #f0eff5); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text-2, #9896a4); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: A left-rail nav item. Quiet at rest (--text-2); active state lights text/icon violet over a soft accent wash — the Violet Lamp marking 'you are here'.
components.html: NotesGraph
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); color: var(--text-2, #9896a4); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--text-1, #f0eff5); background: var(--surface-2, #1c1c21); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: var(--accent, #7c6af7); background: var(--accent-soft, #22202b); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #7c6af7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Composer Pill
components.description: Jnana's signature control: a floating 'take a note' pill at the foot of the content area. It floats, so it casts a real shadow; hovering warms its border to accent.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.5rem; background: var(--surface, #141417); border: 1px solid var(--border-hover, #3d3d4a); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--text-2, #9896a4); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: text; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-pill:hover { color: var(--text-1, #f0eff5); border-color: var(--accent, #7c6af7); } .ds-pill-icon { color: var(--accent, #7c6af7); font-size: 0.95rem; }

narrative.overview: Jnana is a dim, focused desk at night. The room is a deep neutral dark; a single violet lamp throws the only warm light, and everything the user isn't touching recedes into the surfaces. The interface is not the subject — the notes, the graph, the marked-up PDF, the connections between ideas are. Depth is tonal, not dramatic: four stacked neutrals separated by hairline borders do the layering, and real shadows are spent only on things that genuinely float. Type is a single well-tuned sans (Inter) with a mono (JetBrains Mono) reserved for small uppercase labels. The violet accent is rare on purpose — primary actions, current selection, links, and focus, nothing decorative. It rejects loud SaaS marketing UI, sterile enterprise gray, cluttered panel storms, and toy-like gimmickry; warmth is earned through restraint and opt-in themes/plugins.
keyCharacteristics: Deep neutral-dark canvas; tonal layering over shadow for depth
One violet accent used sparingly as a signal, never as decoration
Single sans (Inter) + mono labels (JetBrains Mono); fixed rem scale, tight ratio
Calm and low-chrome at rest; density, speed, and power reveal on demand
Fully user-themeable (Theme Studio) — every color is a token, nothing hardcoded
WCAG 2.1 AA, with a live contrast guardrail across themes

rules.name: The Violet Lamp Rule
rules.body: The accent lights one thing at a time — the primary action, the current selection, a link, or focus — and nothing else. If a screen has violet on more than a small fraction of its surface, it has become decoration; pull it back to a soft neutral wash (accent-soft).

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Every color on screen is a CSS custom property. Hardcoding #7c6af7, an rgba(124,106,247,·) wash, or a hex shadow is forbidden — Theme Studio re-themes by swapping tokens, so a literal silently breaks on the light, sepia, and high-contrast presets.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are fixed rem, never fluid clamp(). Users work at a consistent DPI in a desktop window; a heading that shrinks inside a narrow sidebar looks broken, not responsive.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-A-Label Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for small uppercase labels, captions, timestamps, and code — never body prose or headings. Overusing it makes the UI read as a terminal, which this isn't.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; a shadow appears only because something is floating or responding to state. Never hand-roll a bespoke rgba(0,0,0,·) shadow — pick a --shadow-* step so every floating surface shares one depth language.

dos: Do route every color through a token (var(--accent), var(--surface), var(--text-1)) so Theme Studio can re-theme the whole app in one repaint.
Do convey depth with tonal layering (bg -> surface -> surface-2 -> surface-3) plus 1px hairline borders; reserve --shadow-* for things that actually float.
Do spend the violet accent on one thing at a time — primary action, current selection, link, or focus — and let soft accent-soft washes carry everything accent-adjacent.
Do keep the resting state calm and minimal; reveal density, keyboard power, and advanced controls on demand (command palette, rails, hover chrome).
Do use fixed rem type sizes and a single sans (Inter); keep JetBrains Mono for small uppercase labels and captions only.
Do give every interactive control its full state set (default, hover, :focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, error) and keep the same button/input vocabulary on every screen.
Do verify AA contrast across all Theme Studio presets — including placeholder text — using the built-in guardrail.
donts: Don't ship loud SaaS marketing UI: no gradient-drenched hero-metric dashboards, no purple-on-purple washes, no confetti, no growth-hacky nudges or upsells.
Don't let it read as a sterile enterprise tool — no cold, joyless corporate gray; the dark is warm-neutral and lamp-lit.
Don't crowd the default view into a cluttered, overwhelming Notion/Obsidian-at-its-busiest panel storm; minimum surface is the resting state, density is opt-in.
Don't make it toy-like or gimmicky: no rounded-everything, no oversized playful illustrations, no gamified badges.
Don't hardcode #7c6af7, an rgba(124,106,247,·) wash, or a bespoke rgba(0,0,0,·) shadow — literals break re-theming and fragment the depth language.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, list items, or callouts; use a full hairline border or a soft tonal fill.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text), fluid clamp() UI headings, or display fonts in labels, buttons, and data.
Don't reach for a modal as the first thought — exhaust inline and progressive alternatives; and never nest a card inside a card.
